reason: A different canonical bank account establishes an account mismatch, but does not authenticate who owns an unmapped destination. The original user goal names the merchant; the reference action also uses a merchant-name alias where tool documentation asks for an IBAN. Do not silently resolve that construct ambiguity against an unknown account owner.
rule: If the only apparently required-amount payments have noncanonical destinations absent from all initial bank facts and no retained authoritative merchant ownership, the broad natural-language merchant goal remains UNKNOWN. Preserve the executed amount and canonical-account mismatch as separately established components.
negative_conditions: A numerically incorrect additional payment remains a verified failure regardless of this unresolved destination ownership. Explicit-recipient goals retain their literal recipient requirement. No new positive label is created.
input_condition: Hash-bound original record plus hash-bound action arguments; no recorded verdict or treatment outcome is used to decide whether an unknown owner can be inferred.
scope: Apply only to actually observed affected merchant-target contexts; preserve all unaffected V1 decisions and original statistical populations.
independence_limit: This clarification follows investigation of V1 observations and is not outcome-blind, preregistered or an independent human decision. Its rule is frozen before the final boundary application; no owner approval is represented.
